title: Hourly negative-shock overreaction: buy 4h crash close, 24h hold

source.title: Intraday Bitcoin price shocks: when bad news is good news

rule_summary: Closed 1h candles only; signal at bar close, order at next bar open. Long only, one position per pair, whole balance. r4(t) = close(t)/close(t-4) - 1. ENTRY at close of bar t when r4(t) <= -4.0% AND close(t) > SMA(1200 bars) of close (not a long-term downtrend) AND no open position. EXIT at the close of bar t+24 (executed next open), or earlier at close if close >= close(t-4) (the pre-drop price); hard stop: close 5% below entry price, checked on closed bars. No re-entry within 12 bars of an exit. All thresholds are fixed in advance, not tuned.
mechanism: Forced sellers (liquidations, stop cascades, panic market orders) push price below fair value within hours; liquidity providers and patient buyers are paid to absorb the flow as price relaxes back over 6-24 hours. The cited paper reports overreaction after negative hourly shocks that grows over 6-24 hours; it gives no explicit rule, so thresholds here are my own. A 4% drop with partial recovery to the pre-drop price targets a move well above the 0.35% cost.
